title: 美国三大厂定节奏：不是停发模型，中国实验室会跟吗
speaker: Micah Hill Smith

segments.en: And how do you see this? I mean obviously they're the biggest three and they're competitors, I mean obviously there's one question how far they will go imposing these sort of limits,
segments.zh: 你怎么看？这三家是最大的，也是竞争对手，一个问题就是他们会在多大程度上施加这类限制。

segments.en: but will others follow you think in the industry? There is a particular significance to the top players who are building the models that push the frontier, making this commitment. So I do expect other players in the industry to join this,
segments.zh: 你觉得行业里其他人会跟进吗？推动前沿模型的最头部玩家做出这个承诺，意义特殊。所以我确实预期行业里其他玩家会加入。

segments.en: but it is significant that all of the leading American players just this weekend have made this commitment to and Dario's words pace the frontier.
segments.zh: 但重要的是，就在这个周末，所有领先的美国玩家都做出了这个承诺，用Dario的话说，就是给前沿定节奏。

segments.en: We very much expect to see continued progress, this is not a commitment to stop progress, it's not a commitment to stop releasing models,
segments.zh: 我们非常预期会看到持续进展，这不是承诺停止进步，也不是承诺停止发布模型。

segments.en: it hopefully will just be this mechanism that allows enough time to be taken to make sure that the right safety work is done alongside releasing the models.
segments.zh: 希望它只是一种机制，让各方有足够时间，确保在发布模型的同时做好相应的安全工作。

segments.en: And when you say others would and does that include the Chinese labs, how might this affect their behavior and arguably they are obviously motivated by a different set of incentives, it's you know suffice to say just help us understand the context now.
segments.zh: 你说其他人会跟进，包括中国的实验室吗？这可能会如何影响他们的行为？他们显然有不同的激励。请帮我们理解一下背景。
